requirements.quote:
if (server was at anti-amplification limit):
       SetLossDetectionTimer()
requirements.condition: A received datagram arrives after the server had been blocked by the anti-amplification limit.
requirements.required_behavior: Recompute and arm the loss detection timer by calling SetLossDetectionTimer.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave loss detection unarmed solely because the server was previously amplification-limited.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can unblock an amplification-limited server with a datagram and observe whether the timer is recomputed.

requirements.condition: After an amplification-limited server is unblocked, the recomputed loss detection timeout is already earlier than the current time.
requirements.required_behavior: Immediately execute the loss detection timeout handler.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Wait for a later timer tick instead of executing the already-expired PTO.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A clock-controlled test can make the PTO expire during amplification blocking and verify the timeout callback on unblocking.

requirements.quote:
if (packet.ack_eliciting):
         return true
requirements.condition: At least one packet in the supplied packet collection is ACK-eliciting.
requirements.required_behavior: IncludesAckEliciting returns true.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Return false after encountering an ACK-eliciting packet.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The helper can be exercised with collections containing an ACK-eliciting packet.

requirements.condition: No packet in the supplied packet collection is ACK-eliciting, including when the collection is empty.
requirements.required_behavior: IncludesAckEliciting returns false after examining the collection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Return true when no ACK-eliciting packet is present.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The helper result is directly testable with empty and all-non-ACK-eliciting collections.

requirements.quote:
if (largest_acked_packet[pn_space] == infinite):
       largest_acked_packet[pn_space] = ack.largest_acked
requirements.condition: The largest acknowledged packet value for the packet number space is uninitialized (infinite).
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize it to the largest acknowledged packet number carried by the ACK.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Keep the value infinite or initialize it to a different packet number.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: ACK processing state can be inspected after the first ACK in a packet number space.

requirements.condition: The packet number space already has a finite largest acknowledged packet value.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the stored value to the maximum of its previous value and ack.largest_acked.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Decrease the stored largest acknowledged packet value or overwrite it with a smaller ACK value.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A sequence of ACKs with increasing and decreasing largest values can verify monotonic state.

requirements.condition: An ACK is processed for a packet number space.
requirements.required_behavior: Identify newly acknowledged packets and remove those packets from sent_packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat previously acknowledged packets as newly acknowledged or retain newly acknowledged packets in sent_packets.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The returned newly-acknowledged set and sent-packet state can be checked after ACK processing.

requirements.condition: ACK processing finds no newly acknowledged packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Return from OnAckReceived without performing the later RTT, ECN, loss, congestion-control, PTO-count, or timer-update steps.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Continue through the remaining ACK-processing steps for an ACK that acknowledges nothing new.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A duplicate ACK can be injected while observing whether downstream callbacks and state updates occur.

requirements.quote:
if (newly_acked_packets.largest().packet_number ==
             ack.largest_acked &&
         IncludesAckEliciting(newly_acked_packets)):
       latest_rtt =
         now() - newly_acked_packets.largest().time_sent
requirements.condition: The ACK's largest acknowledged packet is newly acknowledged and at least one newly acknowledged packet is ACK-eliciting.
requirements.required_behavior: Set latest_rtt to the current time minus the send time of the largest newly acknowledged packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Take an RTT sample from a different packet or when either guard condition is false.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled send and receive timestamps make the selected RTT sample and both guards observable.

requirements.quote:
if (newly_acked_packets.largest().packet_number ==
             ack.largest_acked &&
         IncludesAckEliciting(newly_acked_packets)):
       latest_rtt =
         now() - newly_acked_packets.largest().time_sent
       UpdateRtt(ack.ack_delay)
requirements.condition: The ACK's largest acknowledged packet is newly acknowledged and at least one newly acknowledged packet is ACK-eliciting.
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke UpdateRtt with the ACK frame's acknowledgment delay after computing latest_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Update the RTT estimator when the guard is false or pass a delay from another ACK.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify the estimator call, argument, and ordering relative to the RTT sample calculation.

requirements.quote:
if (ACK frame contains ECN information):
         ProcessECN(ack, pn_space)
requirements.condition: A non-duplicate ACK frame contains ECN information.
requirements.required_behavior: Process the ACK's ECN information in the associated packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Ignore present ECN information or process it in a different packet number space.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: ACKs with and without ECN counters can verify conditional invocation and the packet-number-space argument.

requirements.quote: lost_packets = DetectAndRemoveLostPackets(pn_space)
requirements.condition: ACK processing has found at least one newly acknowledged packet and any ECN information has been processed.
requirements.required_behavior: Run loss detection and removal for the ACK's packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Skip loss detection for a newly effective ACK.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Sent-packet loss state and invocation arguments can be observed after an ACK advances acknowledgment state.

requirements.quote:
if (!lost_packets.empty()):
       OnPacketsLost(lost_packets)
requirements.condition: Loss detection during ACK processing returns a nonempty lost-packet set.
requirements.required_behavior: Pass the lost-packet set to OnPacketsLost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omit loss notification for a nonempty lost set or call OnPacketsLost for an empty set.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss-inducing ACK pattern can verify whether the loss callback receives exactly the detected set.

requirements.quote:
lost_packets = DetectAndRemoveLostPackets(pn_space)
     if (!lost_packets.empty()):
       OnPacketsLost(lost_packets)
     OnPacketsAcked(newly_acked_packets)
requirements.condition: ACK processing has a nonempty newly acknowledged set.
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke OnPacketsAcked with the newly acknowledged set after loss detection and any loss notification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Notify acknowledged packets before completing the loss-processing step or omit acknowledgment notification.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Callback tracing can verify both the acknowledged set and its ordering after loss handling.

requirements.quote:
if (PeerCompletedAddressValidation()):
       pto_count = 0
requirements.condition: ACK processing has newly acknowledged packets and peer address validation is complete.
requirements.required_behavior: Reset pto_count to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retain a nonzero PTO backoff count after this condition, or reset it here while peer validation is incomplete.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary peer-validation state and inspect PTO backoff after a newly effective ACK.

requirements.condition: ACK processing has completed for a nonempty newly acknowledged set.
requirements.required_behavior: Recompute the loss detection timer after any conditional PTO-count reset.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave the previous timer schedule unchanged after effective ACK processing.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer state can be compared before and after ACK processing under both validation outcomes.

requirements.quote:
if (first_rtt_sample == 0):
       min_rtt = latest_rtt
requirements.condition: No RTT sample has previously been recorded.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize min_rtt to latest_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initialize min_rtt using acknowledgment delay or a value other than the first latest_rtt sample.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Estimator state is directly inspectable after the first RTT sample.

requirements.condition: No RTT sample has previously been recorded.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize smoothed_rtt to latest_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Apply the steady-state smoothing formula to the first sample.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial smoothed estimate can be asserted after injecting one known RTT sample.

requirements.quote:
if (first_rtt_sample == 0):
       min_rtt = latest_rtt
       smoothed_rtt = latest_rtt
       rttvar = latest_rtt / 2
requirements.condition: No RTT sample has previously been recorded.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize rttvar to one half of latest_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a different initial RTT variance formula.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A known first RTT sample yields an exact expected initial variance.

requirements.quote:
if (first_rtt_sample == 0):
       min_rtt = latest_rtt
       smoothed_rtt = latest_rtt
       rttvar = latest_rtt / 2
       first_rtt_sample = now()
requirements.condition: No RTT sample has previously been recorded.
requirements.required_behavior: Record the current time as first_rtt_sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave first_rtt_sample at zero after initializing the estimator.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock allows the first-sample timestamp transition to be checked exactly.

requirements.quote:
first_rtt_sample = now()
       return
requirements.condition: The RTT estimator has just processed its first sample.
requirements.required_behavior: Return immediately after initialization, without performing the subsequent min, delay-adjustment, variance, or smoothing updates.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Continue into the steady-state RTT update in the same first-sample call.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: First-call estimator outputs distinguish initialization-only behavior from accidental double updating.

requirements.quote:
// min_rtt ignores acknowledgment delay.
     min_rtt = min(min_rtt, latest_rtt)
requirements.condition: UpdateRtt processes a sample after the first RTT sample.
requirements.required_behavior: Set min_rtt to the minimum of the prior min_rtt and the unadjusted latest_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Subtract acknowledgment delay when updating min_rtt or allow min_rtt to increase.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Known latest RTT and ACK-delay values permit exact verification that min_rtt uses the unadjusted sample.

requirements.quote:
if (handshake confirmed):
       ack_delay = min(ack_delay, max_ack_delay)
requirements.condition: The handshake is confirmed while processing a noninitial RTT sample.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit the reported acknowledgment delay to max_ack_delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use an acknowledgment delay greater than max_ack_delay after handshake confirmation.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: An ACK delay above the configured maximum produces a deterministic capped value after confirmation.

requirements.quote:
// Adjust for acknowledgment delay if plausible.
     adjusted_rtt = latest_rtt
requirements.condition: A noninitial RTT sample is being adjusted.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize adjusted_rtt to the unadjusted latest_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Unconditionally subtract acknowledgment delay before checking plausibility.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A sample failing the plausibility condition must retain the exact latest_rtt value.

requirements.quote:
if (latest_rtt >= min_rtt + ack_delay):
       adjusted_rtt = latest_rtt - ack_delay
requirements.condition: latest_rtt is at least min_rtt plus the applicable acknowledgment delay.
requirements.required_behavior: Set adjusted_rtt to latest_rtt minus ack_delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Subtract ack_delay when the plausibility inequality is false, or fail to subtract it when true.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary values immediately below and at the inequality threshold exercise both outcomes.

requirements.quote: rttvar = 3/4 * rttvar + 1/4 * abs(smoothed_rtt - adjusted_rtt)
requirements.condition: A noninitial RTT sample has been adjusted.
requirements.required_behavior: Update rttvar to three quarters of its old value plus one quarter of the absolute difference between the old smoothed_rtt and adjusted_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use different weights, a signed difference, or the newly updated smoothed RTT in this variance calculation.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Known pre-update estimator values produce an exact expected variance result.

requirements.quote: smoothed_rtt = 7/8 * smoothed_rtt + 1/8 * adjusted_rtt
requirements.condition: A noninitial RTT sample has been adjusted.
requirements.required_behavior: Update smoothed_rtt to seven eighths of its old value plus one eighth of adjusted_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use different smoothing weights or the unadjusted RTT when adjustment was applied.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Known pre-update values yield an exact expected smoothed RTT.

requirements.quote:
QUIC loss detection uses a single timer for all timeout loss
   detection.
requirements.condition: The implementation schedules timeout-based QUIC loss detection.
requirements.required_behavior: Use one shared loss detection timer across packet number spaces and timeout modes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Maintain independently firing timeout loss-detection timers that violate the single-timer scheduling model.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer allocation and scheduling state can be inspected to confirm that only one loss-detection deadline is active.

requirements.quote:
Timers set in the past fire
   immediately.
requirements.condition: The loss detection algorithm sets a timer deadline earlier than the current time.
requirements.required_behavior: Fire the timer immediately.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Delay or suppress a timer merely because its deadline is in the past.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled late timer wakeup can verify immediate dispatch of a past deadline.

requirements.quote:
time = loss_time[Initial]
     space = Initial
requirements.condition: GetLossTimeAndSpace begins selecting a loss deadline.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize the candidate time and packet number space from the Initial space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Begin with a different packet number space or an unrelated deadline.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Candidate-selection traces can confirm the initial pair before other spaces are examined.

requirements.condition: GetLossTimeAndSpace examines the Handshake and ApplicationData spaces.
requirements.required_behavior: Replace both candidate time and space when the current candidate time is zero or the examined space has an earlier loss_time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Update only one component of the candidate pair or replace it when neither comparison condition holds.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Configured per-space loss times can exercise each comparison and verify the returned paired selection.

requirements.quote: return time, space
requirements.condition: All packet number spaces have been considered by GetLossTimeAndSpace.
requirements.required_behavior: Return the selected deadline together with its corresponding packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Return a deadline and packet number space from different candidates.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The helper's two return values are directly observable for chosen per-space deadlines.

requirements.quote:
duration = (smoothed_rtt + max(4 * rttvar, kGranularity))
         * (2 ^ pto_count)
requirements.condition: GetPtoTimeAndSpace calculates the base PTO duration.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute duration as (smoothed_rtt + max(4*rttvar, kGranularity)) multiplied by 2 raised to pto_count.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omit the granularity floor or exponential PTO backoff, or apply different arithmetic.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Fixed estimator inputs and PTO counts produce exact expected durations.

requirements.quote:
if (no ack-eliciting packets in flight):
       assert(!PeerCompletedAddressValidation())
requirements.condition: GetPtoTimeAndSpace enters the anti-deadlock branch because no ACK-eliciting packets are in flight.
requirements.required_behavior: Assert that peer address validation has not completed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Compute an anti-deadlock PTO from this branch while treating peer address validation as complete.
requirements.error_behavior: Fail the assertion if the branch is reached with completed peer address validation.
requirements.why_checkable: The branch invariant can be exercised with explicit in-flight and address-validation state.

requirements.quote:
if (has handshake keys):
         return (now() + duration), Handshake
requirements.condition: No ACK-eliciting packets are in flight, address validation is incomplete, and handshake keys are available.
requirements.required_behavior: Return a PTO at now plus duration in the Handshake packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Base this anti-deadlock PTO on an old send time or select the Initial or ApplicationData space.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock and key state make both the deadline base and selected space observable.

requirements.quote:
else:
         return (now() + duration), Initial
requirements.condition: No ACK-eliciting packets are in flight, address validation is incomplete, and handshake keys are unavailable.
requirements.required_behavior: Return a PTO at now plus duration in the Initial packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Select Handshake or ApplicationData without handshake keys, or base the deadline on an old send time.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock and absent handshake keys determine an exact deadline and packet number space.

requirements.quote:
pto_timeout = infinite
     pto_space = Initial
requirements.condition: At least one ACK-eliciting packet is in flight and PTO candidate selection begins.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize the PTO candidate to an infinite timeout associated with the Initial space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Start candidate comparison from a finite unrelated deadline.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Candidate-selection instrumentation can verify the initial sentinel state.

requirements.quote: for space in [ Initial, Handshake, ApplicationData ]:
requirements.condition: PTO selection examines spaces with ACK-eliciting packets in flight.
requirements.required_behavior: Consider packet number spaces in Initial, Handshake, ApplicationData order.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omit a listed space or change the order in a way that bypasses the ApplicationData handshake gate.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Per-space candidate traces reveal which spaces are visited and in what order.

requirements.quote:
if (no ack-eliciting packets in flight in space):
           continue;
requirements.condition: The currently examined packet number space has no ACK-eliciting packet in flight.
requirements.required_behavior: Skip that space without constructing a PTO candidate from it.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Select a PTO based on a space with no ACK-eliciting packet in flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Mixed per-space in-flight state can verify that empty spaces never contribute a deadline.

requirements.condition: PTO selection reaches ApplicationData before handshake confirmation.
requirements.required_behavior: Return the best previously selected PTO candidate without considering ApplicationData.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Arm an ApplicationData PTO before the handshake is confirmed.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: An unconfirmed handshake with ApplicationData packets in flight can verify the selected space excludes ApplicationData.

requirements.quote:
// Include max_ack_delay and backoff for Application Data.
         duration += max_ack_delay * (2 ^ pto_count)
requirements.condition: PTO selection considers ApplicationData after handshake confirmation.
requirements.required_behavior: Add max_ack_delay multiplied by 2 raised to pto_count to the PTO duration.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omit acknowledgment delay, omit its backoff factor, or add this term to non-ApplicationData spaces.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Known delay and PTO-count inputs provide an exact ApplicationData duration increment.

requirements.quote: t = time_of_last_ack_eliciting_packet[space] + duration
requirements.condition: A packet number space with ACK-eliciting packets in flight is eligible for PTO selection.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute its candidate deadline from the last ACK-eliciting packet send time plus the applicable duration.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Base the candidate on current time or a non-ACK-eliciting packet when packets are in flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled send timestamps and estimator inputs yield an exact per-space candidate time.

requirements.condition: A packet number space's PTO candidate is earlier than the current best timeout.
requirements.required_behavior: Replace both pto_timeout and pto_space with that candidate and its space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Keep a later candidate, update only one member of the pair, or replace on an equal/later deadline.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Per-space deadlines with known ordering verify earliest-candidate pair selection.

requirements.quote: return pto_timeout, pto_space
requirements.condition: PTO candidate selection completes across eligible packet number spaces.
requirements.required_behavior: Return the selected timeout together with its corresponding packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Return a timeout and space from different candidates.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The helper's paired return values can be asserted for configured per-space candidates.

requirements.quote:
if (endpoint is server):
       return true
requirements.condition: PeerCompletedAddressValidation is evaluated at a server endpoint.
requirements.required_behavior: Return true.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Require an additional received Handshake ACK or handshake-confirmed flag in this branch.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Endpoint role can be varied while directly observing the helper result.

requirements.quote:
return has received Handshake ACK ||
          handshake confirmed
requirements.condition: PeerCompletedAddressValidation is evaluated outside the preceding server-endpoint branch.
requirements.required_behavior: Return true exactly when a Handshake ACK has been received or the handshake is confirmed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Return true when both conditions are false, or false when either condition is true.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: The two Boolean state inputs can be exhaustively combined and compared with the helper result.

requirements.condition: At least one packet number space has a nonzero time-threshold loss deadline.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the single loss detection timer to earliest_loss_time and return without selecting a PTO deadline.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Prefer an anti-amplification cancellation or PTO deadline over an available time-threshold loss deadline.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Providing a nonzero loss_time allows direct verification of timer priority and the chosen deadline.

requirements.condition: There is no nonzero time-threshold loss deadline and the server is at its anti-amplification limit.
requirements.required_behavior: Cancel the loss detection timer and return because the server cannot send.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Arm a PTO timer while the amplification limit prevents sending.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Amplification budget and loss-time state can be controlled while observing timer cancellation.

requirements.condition: There is no earlier loss-time branch, the server is not blocked by its amplification limit, no ACK-eliciting packet is in flight, and peer address validation is complete.
requirements.required_behavior: Cancel the loss detection timer and return.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Keep a loss/PTO timer armed when there is no ACK-eliciting packet to detect and no anti-deadlock need.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: In-flight packet and validation state can be set explicitly and the timer's cancellation observed.

requirements.quote:
timeout, _ = GetPtoTimeAndSpace()
     loss_detection_timer.update(timeout)
requirements.condition: No time-threshold loss deadline is active, amplification blocking does not require cancellation, and the no-in-flight/validated cancellation condition is false.
requirements.required_behavior: Obtain the PTO deadline and update the single loss detection timer to that timeout.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave the timer unset or use a deadline not returned by GetPtoTimeAndSpace.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified in this excerpt.
requirements.why_checkable: Branch state and the PTO helper result can be controlled while verifying the installed timer deadline.
